target.title: fix(config): cap legacy toolsBySender deprecation warning cache with shared dedupe helper
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in legacy `toolsBySender` deprecation warning deduplication. The `warnedLegacyToolsBySenderKeys` Set accumulated every warned legacy sender key forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap.

Fixes #101643

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced the unbounded `Set` with the existing `createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })` helper from `src/infra/dedupe.ts`. The shared dedupe cache provides `check()` with touch-on-read, max-size pruning via `pruneMapToMaxSize`, and a TTL hook — no bespoke LRU stack needed.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4096 distinct legacy `toolsBySender` keys. Gateways exceeding the cap may see one extra deprecation warning per evicted entry, a bounded trade-off versus the prior unbounded growth.

## Evidence

- `pnpm vitest run --project runtime-config src/config/group-policy.test.ts` — 21 passed
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/config/group-policy.ts src/config/group-policy.test.ts` — 0 warnings, 0 errors

AI-assisted: built with Codex
